release_read.basis: Q3 bookings $316.1m (+12%) beat the company's own guide (search snippet cites $307m) and DAU growth accelerated to 29%; the Q4 bookings guide of $382m (+13%) meets/exceeds the ~$380m the held FY guide implied and FY bookings is raised to $1,296m from $1,285m, so the re-acceleration the short thesis doubted is now both started and guided. Offsets: adj. EBITDA margin 25.5% vs 29.5% a year ago and a Q4 gross-margin step-down on AI costs.
